subject: Activity update: shift to workshop
text:
The plan changed. We now need focus. A workshop suits us better than a walk. Please update the event description. Tuesday is still fine. I can meet at the community room. Ask members to choose a time slot. Bring the sign-up sheet. We should track attendance. The priority is planning skills, not outdoor activity. I will share flyers if you approve the theme. Please confirm. I will wait. Let me know. Soon.

Thanks,
